basics.name: Poojan Shrivastav
basics.label: Full Stack Developer • AI Engineering Student
basics.summary: B.Tech Artificial Intelligence student (Gandhinagar Institute of Technology, 2024–2028). Developer Intern at KaryaUp: joined an existing marketing MVP in Jul 2026 and became the primary engineering contributor on karyaUp_Website (~96% of post-join commits), shipping Analytics HQ, S3/CloudFront media, Vercel migration, KAI streaming/Agent productionization, geo pricing, and SPA SEO. Also Full Stack at 13 UTOPIA across client products (FormX, Navkar, AIA, and more) and Co-Founder at Oneverce (Travebie). Runner-Up at Build With AI Ahmedabad for OpenBridge.

bullets: Joined KaryaUp in Jul 2026 on an existing website MVP; became primary engineering contributor on karyaUp_Website (~96% of commits after join; prior phase ~166 commits by other authors).

Built net-new production systems: first-party Analytics HQ (geo + bot filtering), blog media MongoDB→S3/CloudFront, Vercel SPA migration/deep links, and live app-mock chrome replacing static screenshots.
Productionized KAI chatbot/Agent (1KB proxy stream flush, timeouts/fallbacks, silk/particle UX, mobile tour) and hardened homepage/mobile after GSAP and React 19 production failures.
Shipped IP geo pricing (INR/USD), SPA crawl SEO (canonicals, prerender, sitemap), lean blog list projections, and PageSpeed/TBT work while restoring visuals when deferrals went too far.
Delivered FormX Consultants — 40+ route Next.js 16 / React 19 architectural consulting platform with a custom brand design system.
Built Navkar Tubes & Tools — industrial B2B site with interactive pipe weight calculator, MTC inspection UI, and Express serverless inquiry APIs.
Shipped Travebie (travebie.com), an AI travel booking platform with a 19-intent engine and 18 dynamic chat card UI components.
Added Playwright E2E coverage across booking/planner flows and PWA offline caching with a React Native admin companion.
